description_for_human: Drafts a procurement / replacement-parts ticket from a list of affected assets.
description_for_model: Use this action to draft a procurement ticket text when the user asks to order replacement hardware, drives, or other parts based on a set of assets returned by a prior grounding query. Input: a short context note + a list of asset hostnames. Output: ticket draft (subject, body, justification, suggested vendor).

functions.name: drafTicket
functions.description: Draft a procurement ticket for replacement parts.

context.description: Short justification, e.g. 'Q2 disk failure pattern in Building B'.

runtime.note: Replace with your deployed action API. For the demo, this is mocked in demo/app.py.
